macros.name: dmulticolumn
macros.doc: \dmulticolumn{⟨count⟩}{⟨preamble⟩}{⟨formula⟩} is used in darray instead of \multicolumn.

macros.name: medint
macros.doc: The \medint{⟨operator⟩} command prepares a medium-size integral with required preference for limits.

macros.name: medintcorr
macros.doc: The \medintcorr{⟨length⟩} command specifies the value of italic correction for medium integrals.

macros.name: medmath
macros.doc: The \medmath{⟨formula⟩} command decreases a size of formula in 1.2 times and prepares it in the display style.

macros.name: medop
macros.doc: The \medop{⟨operator⟩} command prepares a medium-size operator with the required preference for limits.

macros.name: mrel
macros.doc: The \mrel{⟨column⟩} command composes a new math relation symbol from a one-column stack of math formulas described in the ⟨column⟩ parameter.

macros.name: nr
macros.doc: The \nr command has just the same syntax as \\ but adds 0.5ex extra vertical space between lines.

macros.name: useshortskip
